name: SimpleQA Verified
intro: SimpleQA Verified 从原 SimpleQA 的4326题中通过来源去重、主题平衡、冲突来源调和、难度筛选与人工复核构建1000道无工具短事实问答，用于更可靠地测量参数知识事实性。
build_method: 多阶段去重与平衡, 来源调和, 前沿模型难度筛选, 人工复核
metric: F1, Accuracy, Correct Given Attempted, Attempted Rate
eval_feature: 无工具参数知识, 三分类自动判分, 数值可接受区间
build_method_en: Multi-stage de-duplication and balancing, source reconciliation, frontier-model difficulty filtering, and manual review
eval_feature_en: No-tool parametric knowledge, ternary automatic grading, and item-specific numeric ranges
intro_en: SimpleQA Verified filters the original 4,326 SimpleQA prompts into 1,000 no-tool short factual questions through source de-duplication, topic balancing, source reconciliation, difficulty filtering, and manual review.
metric_en: F1, Accuracy, Correct Given Attempted, Attempted Rate

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SimpleQA Verified arXiv:2509.07968 Sections 2-3 and Appendix A; official Google DeepMind Kaggle benchmark. SimpleQA Verified filters and corrects OpenAI's 4,326-item SimpleQA to create a 1,000-prompt no-tool parametric-factuality benchmark. The authors retain one question per source document, then apply Gemini-embedding and TF-IDF de-duplication, remove sources whose publishers opt out via crawler controls, and rebalance answer types and topics. Search-augmented model ensembles reconcile conflicting nonnumeric answers and numeric answers within a five-percent margin; numeric ground truths are rewritten with item-specific acceptable ranges. Frontier-model difficulty filtering retains 1,000 hard prompts. Manual review then repairs URLs and date precision and adds reasoning and multi-step metadata. Models answer with standard API settings and no tools. GPT-4.1 grades each response correct, incorrect, or not attempted using a revised prompt that handles numeric ranges, extra information, hedging, and varied refusal styles. Accuracy, correct-given-attempted, attempted rate, hedged rate, and their harmonic F1 are reported.
